La moneda llegó a cotizar por debajo de 1,12 dólares, mientras aumentaban los costos de financiación franceses y caía la Bolsa de París. La incertidumbre se vio agravada además por la convocatoria de elecciones anticipadas en España. Los mercados temen que la inestabilidad política dificulte la reducción del déficit francés y reavive tensiones similares a las de la crisis de deuda europea de la década pasada. | DW Español

item.title: D’Arros shearwater colony grew nearly 10-fold after rats were eradicated
item.description: D'Arros Island's Wedge-tailed Shearwater population rose dramatically after rats were eradicated in 2003. Researchers recorded 2,768 breeding pairs in 2016 and 2,406 pairs in 2021. The colony spread across a larger area and exhibited higher breeding burrow density during later surveys. The study utilized direct counts and area-based estimates to determine breeding pair numbers. Identifying the peak incubation period in November was crucial for future population comparisons. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Concerns of US interference weigh on Brazil vote
item.description: Conservative Senator Flavio Bolsonaro pulled off a surprise on Sunday in the first round of Brazil’s presidential election by finishing ahead of the incumbent left-wing President Lula, whom he will face in the runoff on October 25. Suspicions of U.S. interference have been hanging over the campaign, even as Donald Trump has never hidden his closeness to the far-right former president Bolsonaro - Flavio’s father - and his animosity toward Lula da Silva. FRANCE 24's Emerald Maxwell reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
item.description: An invisible, machine-readable watermark in text output is rolling out to ChatGPT and Codex, but only for users in the European Union at first. OpenAI says its textGrain watermarking "matched or exceeded" other approaches like Google DeepMind's SynthID for text, which is also the basis for the watermarking Anthropic announced in August. item.title: London to Chicago BA flight declares emergency after dropping 28,000 feet
item.description: British Airways Boeing abruptly lost altitude over Ireland due to ‘technical issue’ and returned to Heathrow A flight from London to Chicago declared an emergency after a sudden and steep descent of 28,000 feet over Ireland and was forced to turn back to Britain. British Airways flight BA295 was bound for Chicago’s O’Hare airport but after a “technical issue” during which oxygen masks were deployed from the ceiling, the plane landed safely back at London Heathrow. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
